account: Today seems quiet so far. Residents I asked on my morning market walk reported no news. I reviewed the treasury during the scheduled town accounts period: it held 128 emeralds, which I left untouched. I have not learned of any urgent bills or council business. The main complication was my fifteen hundred tea appointment: the appointment book described only a neighbour in an east-bank dockside cottage, without an address. The secretary offered to find the host. I later heard her speaking and shouting but could not make out her words, so I do not know what she was trying to convey. I crossed to the east bank and found the neighbour waiting at the cottage road point (16,105), arriving at 15:19. The neighbour welcomed me, said all was well, and confirmed the secretary had kindly checked on our tea. That suggests the secretary's trip was simply to clarify the invitation, not evidence of trouble. I have asked whether any riverside matters need my attention and am awaiting an answer. It is now 16:00, and I am due back at the office at 16:30. Nothing I have directly observed establishes any unusual or suspicious activity in town today.
